semantic.justification: Iteration113 introduces the document-owned automatic character StylePool and IStyleAccess/SwStyleManager owner. Concrete SET-only parent-root/item-child/leaf-clone insertion shares handles for shareable items and retains fresh leaves for non-shareable items. Ordinary character creation and browser snapshot decode now use the document pool. SwFormatAutoFormat is non-shareable, retains explicitly supplied handles, copies the shared reference and compares pointer identity rather than item-set value equality. Independent real-owner regressions cover insertion/parent/input/copy/adjacent-range/codec contracts; one obsolete raw-value merge expectation is corrected. Selective reset pool interning, sentinel-bearing style insertion, native unordered iterator order/collisions, paragraph/ignorable families, unused-style enumeration, name/cache/lifetime semantics, native null default constructor and UNO name QueryValue remain unverified. Browser item-record persistence remains the existing adapter; full modules/model/layout/notification/filter/UI parity is not certified. Registered save/open/recovery deviations and existing semantic statuses/defaults/exceptions remain unchanged. Iteration114 restores the registered MakeTextAttr owner for item-set insertion, character WhichId wrapping, same-pool automatic/internet item copies and foreign automatic-style Clone(true,destinationPool) conversion. Selective reset now interns a nonempty remaining set and constructs a fresh hint through MakeTextAttr, reusing native document-owned handles so equivalent adjacent remnants merge. Internet items are non-shareable. Snapshot decoding uses the same factory while retaining browser item records. Independent real-owner factory/reset/retained-undo/adjacent-range tests cover these bounded contracts. Two earlier synthetic sentinel replacement assumptions are corrected to the existing concrete-pool excluded-domain guard; valid concrete flag fixtures preserve core fresh defaults and actual Ctrl deletion/undo/redo. No-common raw state handling remains independently tested. This supersedes older positive sentinel-pooling and missing selective handle-routing claims only in the registered operation. Sentinel style insertion, native unordered iteration/collisions, paragraph/ignorable/cache/name/usage/lifetime/null constructor/UNO name QueryValue, other hint types and actual cross-document SwpHints copy ingestion remain unverified. Whole-module/model/filter/UI parity stays unverified; all existing statuses/defaults/exceptions and registered I/O/recovery deviations unchanged.
